but a field may never be added to it
and the refusal leaves the registered definition untouched
an entity round-trips through the document
RecognizedField answers for every field of the entity's own schema
and the measurement left the document unmodified
the model survey answers
the modal window was raised on the API thread
and it closed itself, with nobody there to close it
work posted to the pump does not run while the window is up
and it runs as soon as the window closes
an await inside the window resumes
and it resumes on the API thread
the Revit API answers a direct read from inside the window
and it still answers after an await has resumed
a transaction opens inside the window after an await
and commits a real modification there
and the group puts the document back as it was
the continuation lands back in the window's own context
the context inside the window is WPF's dispatcher
and outside it Revit's own context is WinForms
a file is written for every language, not only this Revit's
and Revit finds our parameter in each of them
the two files call one parameter by two names
the user's own shared parameter file is put back afterwards
binding puts every declared parameter into the model
and the parameter is found by its identifier, not its name
under the name from the file this Revit reads
and the group leaves the document without it
a DBApplication add-in starts the same host
and it is keyed by its own add-in id, beside the interface one
both add-in ids are found in the registry
and they are two hosts, not one answering twice
the interface host offers the API thread and the DB host does not
both forms were called on the same API thread
a module starts in the DB host too
and it is given its own settings section
startup there is not yet Revit having started, as in the interface form
settings from disk are read there too
asking for the API thread there is refused, in a sentence
and Revit tells it that it has finished starting, session or no session
every assembly Revit substituted is one RefCheck vets
the diagnostic stream carries what Revit is doing
every phase arrived on Revit's API thread
the publisher accounted for everything it dropped
opening a model is visible as it happens
and so is the document becoming usable
Revit closes on an ExitRevit posted from inside
the registry drops it when the process goes
the DB host is taken down on the way out, like the interface one
and its module is stopped with it
